body:
⚒️ CraftingAble – The Ultimate SMP Enhancement Plugin

CraftingAble is a custom Minecraft SMP plugin designed to make survival gameplay more rewarding and exciting. It introduces skill progression, custom crafting recipes, playtime tracking, starter kits, and quality-of-life features that improve the vanilla experience without changing its core feel.

✨ Features:
• Mining, Woodcutting, and Combat Skills
• Playtime Tracking (/pt)
• Skills Command & GUI
• First Join Starter Stone Tools
• Custom Chat Formatting
• Custom Crafting Recipes:

- Saddle
- Name Tag
- Horse Armor
- Experience Bottles
- Enhanced Trapdoor Recipe
- Paper from Logs
- Totem of Undying Recipe
  • Lightweight & SMP Friendly
  • Built for Paper/Spigot Servers

Whether you're running a private SMP with friends or a larger community server, CraftingAble adds progression and convenience while keeping Minecraft fun and balanced.
